source.origin_description: Archive README names Stooq primary / Yahoo secondary. Not independently audited.
source.price_adjustment: Archive says close adjusted for dividends and splits; third-party claim unverified.
source.redistribution: No raw third-party historical market files included; check usage rights.

methodology.benchmark_cost_method: Charge single initial SPY buy; no end liquidation fee
methodology.other_benchmark: SPY_benchmark_no_cost retained solely for continuity and transparency
methodology.bootstrap_meaning: circular paired-block CI for annualized arithmetic mean daily excess
methodology.bootstrap_multiple_comparisons_warning: Three comparisons; unadjusted intervals are exploratory

risk_backtest.warning: Large-sample chi-square p-values have low power at 99% with few breaches

methodology.backtest_timing: Allocation at t uses price changes ending at t-1 or earlier
methodology.crisis_labels: Ex-post date windows; only genuine historical market events for a verified archive input, otherwise calendar-window engineering checks
methodology.market_data: Third-party archive claims prices adjusted for splits/dividends; not independently audited and may be subject to redistribution restrictions
methodology.execution: Daily close-to-close approximation; assumed commission+slippage, not executed fills
research_limits: look-ahead-free algorithm does not make selection point-in-time
no order book or real ADV
observed results do not imply predictive success
source vendor rights not independently verified

data_quality.warning: Flags are triage, not proof of data errors. Splits, total-return and calendar assumptions must be checked against vendor records.

disclosure: Research results only; no raw vendor price archive distributed.
